meta.name: grilling
meta.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

copy.tagline: 挑战并检验你的想法和决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要有人帮你严格审视计划或决策的漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test your plans and decisions with relentless questioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need someone to rigorously challenge your thinking and uncover blind spots.

howto.what: Claude 会像面试官一样，针对你的计划、决策或想法，逐一提出尖锐问题，直到双方达成共识。它每次只问一个问题，等你回答后再继续，并会主动查找环境中的事实，而不是问你。
howto.when: 当你想要压力测试自己的思考，或说出“grill”等触发词时，Claude 会启动这个技能。

say.text: 帮我严格审查这个创业计划。
say.note: Claude 会开始逐项提问，直到计划被充分讨论。

say.text: Grill 一下我关于换工作的决定。

howto.what_en: Claude will act like an interviewer, relentlessly questioning your plan, decision, or idea one at a time, waiting for your answer before proceeding. It will look up facts from the environment rather than asking you.
howto.when_en: When you want to stress-test your thinking or use trigger phrases like 'grill', Claude will activate this skill.

say_en.text: Grill me on this business plan.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions until shared understanding is reached.

say_en.text: Stress-test my decision to change jobs.
say_en.note: Uses the skill's purpose without explicit trigger.
